exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.notes: Start in plank position, lower body to ground, push back up

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.notes: Keep your back flat and feet on the ground

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
exercises.notes: Slight bend in elbows, lower until a stretch is felt across the chest

exercises.name: Incline Push-ups
exercises.notes: Hands elevated on a bench or step; easier than a floor push-up

exercises.name: Band Chest Press
exercises.notes: Anchor the band behind you and press forward at chest height

exercises.name: Landmine Press
exercises.notes: Press at roughly 45 degrees -- avoids the neck extension a strict overhead press needs

exercises.name: Decline Push-up
exercises.notes: Feet elevated, which shifts the load onto the upper chest

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.notes: Slight elbow bend, meet the handles in front of the sternum

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.notes: Full range of motion, chin over bar

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.notes: Keep your back straight and core engaged

exercises.name: Barbell Rows
exercises.notes: Pull to your lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Pull the bar to your upper chest, avoid leaning back excessively

exercises.name: Band Row
exercises.notes: Anchor at waist height, pull elbows past your ribs

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.notes: Body under a bar or sturdy table, pull chest to the bar

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.notes: Chest tall, pull to the navel without leaning back

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.notes: Face down, lift chest and thighs; reps field tracks seconds held

exercises.name: Reverse Snow Angel
exercises.notes: Face down, sweep straight arms from hips to overhead without touching the floor

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.notes: Arms straight, pull the band apart across the chest

exercises.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Knee and hand braced on a bench, pull the elbow past the ribs

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Press straight up, keep core tight

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.notes: Raise dumbbells to the sides until arms are parallel to the floor

exercises.name: Band Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Stand on the band, raise to shoulder height

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Pull to the forehead with elbows high; a rear-delt and posture staple

exercises.name: Pike Push-up
exercises.notes: Hips high, lower the crown of the head to the floor -- a bodyweight overhead press

exercises.name: Wall Handstand Hold
exercises.notes: Feet on the wall, shoulders stacked; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.notes: Raise to eye level with no swing

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.notes: Cross the cables and open wide, squeezing the rear delts

exercises.name: Kettlebell Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Press from the rack position with the ribs down

exercises.name: Bicep Curls
exercises.notes: Keep elbows pinned to your sides, curl with control

exercises.name: Band Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Stand on the band, curl with elbows pinned

exercises.name: Underhand Inverted Row
exercises.notes: Supine row with an underhand grip, under a bar or a sturdy table

exercises.name: Towel Curl
exercises.notes: Loop a towel under one foot and curl against your own resistance

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.notes: Underhand grip, pull the chest to the bar -- the biceps mass builder

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Neutral grip throughout; biases the brachialis

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.notes: Constant tension through the whole range

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.notes: Lower until shoulders are below elbows

exercises.name: Bench Dips
exercises.notes: Hands on a bench behind you, feet forward

exercises.name: Band Triceps Pushdown
exercises.notes: Anchor high, extend the elbows fully

exercises.name: Diamond Push-up
exercises.notes: Hands together under the sternum; the bodyweight triceps builder

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.notes: One dumbbell in both hands, elbows pointing forward

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: Lying down, lower to the forehead with the upper arms still

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.notes: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, lower body as if sitting back into a chair

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: No load on the spine, unlike a barbell back squat

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.notes: Step onto a knee-height box, control the way down

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.notes: Isometric hold -- quad work without knee travel; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Back supported throughout

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Step backwards rather than forwards -- much kinder on the knee

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Rear foot elevated, torso tall, weight through the front heel

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold the weight at the chest; the counterweight keeps the torso upright

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge at the hips, keep the bar close to your legs

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.notes: Hip hinge, not a squat -- power comes from the glutes

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Isolates the hamstrings with no spinal load

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
exercises.notes: Anchor the ankles and lower the torso as slowly as you can, then push back

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Bridge Walkout
exercises.notes: From a bridge, walk the heels away and back while keeping the hips high

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Hinge on one leg with a flat back, the other leg extending behind as a counterweight

exercises.name: Band Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Anchor the band at the ankle and curl the heel towards the glute

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.notes: Step forward, lower back knee toward the ground, alternate legs

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the heels; loads the hips with the spine supported

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: One foot planted, the other knee hugged in; keep the hips level

exercises.name: Band Lateral Walk
exercises.notes: Band above the knees, small controlled steps with the tension held

exercises.name: Cable Kickback
exercises.notes: Hinge slightly and drive the heel back without arching the lower back

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Shoulders on a bench, bar across the hips, full lockout at the top

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Rise onto your toes, pause, lower slowly

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Full stretch at the bottom, pause at the top

exercises.name: Band Calf Press
exercises.notes: Seated with the band over the ball of the foot, press the toes away

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Knees bent to bias the soleus

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Hold a straight line from shoulders to ankles; reps field tracks seconds held

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Lower opposite arm and leg with the low back flat; head stays down

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Hold a straight line from shoulder to ankle; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.notes: Opposite arm and leg extended, spine neutral -- a common low-back rehab staple

exercises.name: Farmer Carry
exercises.notes: Heavy in both hands, ribs down, walk tall; reps field tracks metres

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Loaded on one side only, and you refuse to lean; reps field tracks metres

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.notes: Press straight out against a side-on band and resist the rotation

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.notes: Plank position, drive the knees in alternately without the hips rising

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Hang from a bar and curl the knees up; no swinging

exercises.name: Brisk Walk
exercises.notes: Low impact; reps field tracks minutes

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.notes: Low impact on the ankles and spine; reps field tracks minutes

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.notes: Light on the toes; reps field tracks minutes

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.notes: Squat, kick back, push up, jump; reps field tracks minutes

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.notes: Legs, then hips, then arms; reps field tracks minutes

exercises.name: Shoulder Pendulum
exercises.notes: Lean forward, let the arm hang and circle gently; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Band External Rotation
exercises.notes: Elbow tucked at your side, rotate the forearm outwards -- rotator-cuff staple

exercises.name: Scapular Wall Slide
exercises.notes: Forearms on the wall, slide up and down keeping contact

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
exercises.notes: Draw the chin straight back without tilting; deep neck flexor work

exercises.name: Neck Isometric Hold
exercises.notes: Press the head lightly into your hand without movement; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.notes: On all fours, alternate arching and rounding the spine slowly

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilt
exercises.notes: Lying down, flatten the low back into the floor and release

exercises.name: Straight Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Quad activation without bending the knee -- standard post-knee-injury work

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.notes: Band behind the knee, straighten against the resistance

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet
exercises.notes: Trace the alphabet with the toes to restore ankle range

exercises.name: Heel Raise (Seated)
exercises.notes: Seated so bodyweight is off the joint; rebuilds calf and ankle

exercises.name: Wrist & Elbow Extension
exercises.notes: Slow eccentric wrist extension -- the standard tennis-elbow protocol

exercises.name: Forearm Supination
exercises.notes: Rotate the palm up against light resistance, elbow tucked

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.notes: Side-lying, knees bent, open the top knee -- glute medius work

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Arm straight, gently pull the fingers back; hold and release

exercises.name: Elbow Range of Motion
exercises.notes: Slow full bend and straighten, no load

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
exercises.notes: Knee travels over the toes with the heel down

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.notes: Half-kneeling, tuck the pelvis and lean forward gently

exercises.name: Prone Y Raise
exercises.notes: Face down, arms in a Y, lift the thumbs towards the ceiling

exercises.name: Wall Angel
exercises.notes: Back flat to the wall, arms trace an arc without losing contact

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.notes: Forearm on the frame, rotate away gently; hold and release

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
exercises.notes: Arm straight, gently press the fingers down -- the tennis-elbow counterpart

exercises.name: Towel Wrist Twist
exercises.notes: Wring a towel slowly in both directions for eccentric forearm work

exercises.name: Grip Squeeze
exercises.notes: Squeeze a rolled towel or ball and hold; reps field tracks seconds

exercises.name: Quad Set
exercises.notes: Leg straight, press the back of the knee down and hold the contraction

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.notes: Stand on one leg; reps field tracks seconds. Proprioception is the point

exercises.name: Heel Walk
exercises.notes: Walk on the heels with the toes lifted -- dorsiflexor strength

exercises.name: Toe Walk
exercises.notes: Walk on the toes with the heels high; the calf counterpart to the heel walk

exercises.name: Band Ankle Eversion
exercises.notes: Turn the sole outwards against the band -- the classic sprain rebuild

exercises.name: Piriformis Stretch
exercises.notes: Ankle across the opposite knee, draw the thigh in; hold and release

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: Lift the leg out to the side without leaning; hold a wall for balance

exercises.name: Upper Trap Stretch
exercises.notes: Ear towards the shoulder, hand resting on the head for weight only

exercises.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
exercises.notes: Look towards the armpit and let the head fall gently that way

exercises.name: Knee-to-Chest Stretch
exercises.notes: On your back, draw one knee in at a time; hold and release

exercises.name: Prone Press-up
exercises.notes: Face down, press the chest up leaving the hips down -- gentle extension

workoutTemplates.name: Full Body A
workoutTemplates.notes:
Every major pattern

Leave 2 rep(s) in reserve on every set. When you hit 8 reps on all 4 sets, add 2.5kg upper body / 5kg lower body next time. Weights shown are a starting estimate -- adjust on your first set.
